citations.quote: In Study 302, patients were randomly assigned (1:1) to receive either delafloxacin, 300 mg IV q12h, or vancomycin, 15 mg/kg IV q12h plus aztreonam, 2 g q12h.

endpoint.text: Objective response of >=20% reduction in lesion erythema compared with baseline at 48 to 72 hours after initiation of therapy, with no evidence of clinical failure; prespecified noninferiority margin of -10%

citations.quote: In both trials, the primary endpoint was objective response of \ge20% reduction in lesion erythema compared with baseline as determined by digital measurement of the leading edge at 48 to 72 hours (\pm2 hours) after initiation of therapy, with no evidence of clinical failure.
In both trials, the pre-specified noninferiority margin was -10%.
